confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Vilnius price indexes. The price sources were crowdsourced or dated (one from 2023). They gave beer, cappuccino and the two restaurant meal anchors. No Vilnius cocktail price was found, so I set the cocktail anchor at roughly 2.3 times the beer price. The wine glass anchor is a judgement from the bottle price and typical restaurant markups. The RBA 2026-11-19 figure was marked provisional in the search result, so I used the confirmed 2026-11-18 rate. The accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, with no listings checked, and are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to Riga and Tallinn, with Vilnius slightly cheaper than Tallinn. I used Baltic capital price levels and typical hostel and hotel pricing for the region.
